name: glibc
description: GNU C Library, used exclusively as a bootstrap-only toolchain dependency (with GCC and binutils) to build the initial NullOS system before switching to musl. Not part of the final system.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
